title: Implicit causality in GPT-2: a case study

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing next-word surprisal values for subject-congruent versus object-congruent pronouns following verbs with known implicit causality biases, and collecting human evaluations to assess the logical coherence of the model's generated continuations.

Analyzing the effect of subject gender on the model's performance by comparing next-word surprisal values and generated pronoun distributions across prompts that feature grammatically male versus female noun pairs.
